isolates: check 6, the set-level earliest-retrieved_at comparison (rev2 l.95-97, Finding 12), seeded and iterated over pinnedEntries instead of sources
why: The set-level retrieved_at equals the UNPINNED entry's value, which is earlier than the pinned entry's. The baseline takes the earliest over every source, finds the unpinned value, and accepts; the f32a build takes the earliest over the pinned entries only, finds the later value, and halts. This is the one probe whose polarity is reversed: the baseline passes and the variant halts.
